## Code Puzzle

::: static
Error <- rnorm(n = {{{100}}}, mean = {{{0}}}, sd = {{{8}}})
x <- {{{rnorm(n = 100, mean = 20, sd = 10) OR rnorm(mean = 20, sd = 10, n = 100)}}}
{{beta}} <- # choose your own number between 0 and 1
:::

{{y}} <- beta*{{x}} + {{Error}}

df <- tibble(Depression = {{{y}}}, Addiction = {{{x}}})

ggplot({{{df}}}, {{{aes(x = Addiction, y = Depression) OR aes(y = Depression, x = Addiction)}}}) + {{geom_point()}}

## Plot

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-align: center
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

data <- read_csv("data/depAndSocMed.csv")

ggplot(data, aes(x=time, y=dep)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method="lm")
```
